verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents converting a URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. That is a choice of output format, not semantic chunking: nothing in the pack shows it splitting content into retrieval-ready chunks. The axis applies to a web-context fetching product, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
